readme.markdown:
Famulor MCP

Control your Famulor AI voice agents — calls, leads, campaigns, knowledge bases, conversations, WhatsApp, SIP trunks — directly from Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code and any other MCP-compatible client.

mcp.famulor.io · Get an API key · Docs

--- ## Setup Add the server in your editor, then sign in with your [Famulor API key](https://app.famulor.de/api-keys) when prompted in the browser. > **Server URL**: `https://mcp.famulor.io/mcp` is the canonical endpoint. > Both `https://mcp.famulor.io/` and `https://mcp.famulor.io/mcp` work as MCP > URLs, so you can paste either into your client's connector dialog.
Claude Code ```bash claude mcp add --transport http famulor https://mcp.famulor.io/mcp ``` Add the server first — authenticate via your [API key](https://app.famulor.de/api-keys) when prompted.
Claude Desktop **Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector** ``` https://mcp.famulor.io/mcp ``` Copy the URL, paste it into the connector dialog, and sign in when prompted.
Cursor `.cursor/mcp.json` ```json { "mcpServers": { "famulor": { "type": "http", "url": "https://mcp.famulor.io/mcp" } } } ``` Add the server first — authenticate via your [API key](https://app.famulor.de/api-keys) when prompted.
Windsurf `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json` ```json { "mcpServers": { "famulor": { "serverUrl": "https://mcp.famulor.io/mcp" } } } ``` Add the server first — authenticate via your [API key](https://app.famulor.de/api-keys) when prompted.
VS Code `.vscode/mcp.json` ```json { "servers": { "famulor": { "type": "http", "url": "https://mcp.famulor.io/mcp" } } } ``` Add the server first — authenticate via your [API key](https://app.famulor.de/api-keys) when prompted.
Cline **Cline extension > MCP Servers > Configure** ```json { "mcpServers": { "famulor": { "url": "https://mcp.famulor.io/mcp" } } } ``` Add the server first — authenticate via your [API key](https://app.famulor.de/api-keys) when prompted.
Continue `~/.continue/config.yaml` ```yaml mcpServers: - name: famulor type: streamable-http url: "https://mcp.famulor.io/mcp" ``` Add the server first — authenticate via your [API key](https://app.famulor.de/api-keys) when prompted.
OpenClaw ```bash openclaw mcp add famulor --url https://mcp.famulor.io/mcp --transport streamable-http --auth oauth openclaw mcp login famulor ``` Or in `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json`: ```json { "mcp": { "servers": { "famulor": { "url": "https://mcp.famulor.io/mcp", "transport": "streamable-http", "auth": "oauth" } } } } ``` Tip: there is also a ready-made Famulor skill — `openclaw skills install famulor-skill`.
Hermes Agent ```bash hermes mcp add famulor --url https://mcp.famulor.io/mcp hermes mcp login famulor ``` Or in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`: ```yaml mcp_servers: famulor: url: "https://mcp.famulor.io/mcp" auth: oauth ``` Apply in-session with `/reload-mcp`.
npx (stdio, any MCP client) Run the server locally via npm — no hosted endpoint needed. Uses your [Famulor API key](https://app.famulor.de/api-keys) directly: ```json { "mcpServers": { "famulor": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "famulor-mcp"], "env": { "FAMULOR_API_KEY": "your-api-key" } } } } ```
Zed `~/.config/zed/settings.json` ```json { "context_servers": { "famulor": { "args": [ "-y", "mcp-remote@latest", "https://mcp.famulor.io/mcp" ], "command": "npx" } } } ``` Add the server first — authenticate via your [API key](https://app.famulor.de/api-keys) when prompted.
--- ## What you can do Once connected, your AI assistant can call any of the **66 tools** spanning the full Famulor API. A non-exhaustive tour: **Assistants** — create, update, delete AI voice agents · list voices, languages, LLM/multimodal models, TTS/STT providers · toggle inbound and conversation-ended webhooks **Calls** — make outbound calls · list / get / delete call records **Campaigns** — create campaigns, manage retry rules and allowed-hours windows · start, stop and delete **Leads** — add leads (incl. secondary contacts) · update status and merge variables · delete **Knowledge bases** — create knowledge bases · upload website-scraped documents · update / delete **Phone numbers** — search by country and dial pattern · purchase · release · SIP trunk CRUD **Conversations** — list, read and reply to chat conversations · enable/disable AI per conversation for human takeover **WhatsApp** — list senders and templates · check 24h session window · send template or freeform messages **SMS** — send via your purchased numbers **Mid-call tools** — register custom HTTP integrations the assistant can call mid-conversation **AI Replies** — generate context-aware replies for external chat platforms Ask the assistant in plain English, e.g. *"Create a German sales assistant using GPT-4.1-mini and the Susi voice"*, *"Start campaign #42 and add these 50 leads"*, *"Show me all calls today where the goal wasn't reached."* --- ## How auth works The server speaks the standard MCP OAuth 2.1 flow (RFC 8414 metadata, RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration, PKCE S256). Your MCP client opens a browser tab, you paste your Famulor API key, and the client receives an access token that the server encrypts with AES-256-GCM. **Your API key never lands in any database** — it lives only inside the token your client stores. Tokens expire after 30 days; your client simply re-prompts. --- ## Self-hosting The hosted server at `https://mcp.famulor.io` works out of the box, but you can run your own if you prefer. ### Deploy to Vercel ```bash git clone https://github.com/bekservice/Famulor-MCP.git cd Famulor-MCP vercel --prod ``` Set these env vars in the Vercel project: | Variable | Required | Value | | ------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | | `MCP_SECRET` | yes | `openssl rand -hex 32` — encrypts OAuth tokens. | | `MCP_ISSUER` | rec. | Your public URL, e.g. `https://mcp.example.com`. | Then point your domain at the deployment and you're live. See [DEPLOYMENT.md](./DEPLOYMENT.md) for the full guide including stdio mode for power users. ### Local dev ```bash npm install echo "MCP_SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 32)" > .env npm run dev:http # server on http://localhost:8787 ``` ```bash # health curl http://localhost:8787/health # OAuth metadata curl http://localhost:8787/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server ``` --- ## License MIT

toolsPreview.name: get_me
toolsPreview.description: Get the authenticated Famulor user profile, including total balance.

toolsPreview.name: get_assistants
toolsPreview.description: List all AI assistants on the Famulor account (paginated). Returns the assistant configurations including their fixed variable names.

toolsPreview.name: get_outbound_assistants
toolsPreview.description: List all outbound-capable assistants.

toolsPreview.name: get_phone_numbers
toolsPreview.description: List phone numbers eligible to be attached to an assistant (filter by inbound/outbound).

toolsPreview.name: get_models
toolsPreview.description: List available LLM / multimodal / dualplex model IDs.

toolsPreview.name: get_voices
toolsPreview.description: List voices compatible with a given engine mode and optional language.

toolsPreview.name: get_languages
toolsPreview.description: List all supported assistant languages.

toolsPreview.name: get_synthesizer_providers
toolsPreview.description: List custom TTS providers selectable on an assistant.

toolsPreview.name: get_transcriber_providers
toolsPreview.description: List custom STT providers selectable on a pipeline assistant.

toolsPreview.name: create_assistant
toolsPreview.description: Create a new AI assistant. Required: name, voice_id, language_id, type, mode, timezone, initial_message, system_prompt, and either llm_model_id (pipeline) or multimodal_model_id (multimodal/dualplex). For multimodal/dualplex, knowledgebase_mode must be "function_call" when a knowledgebase is attached.

toolsPreview.name: update_assistant
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing assistant (partial). Only the fields you send are changed.

toolsPreview.name: delete_assistant
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete an assistant. Cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: enable_assistant_inbound_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Enable inbound-call webhook notifications for an assistant.

toolsPreview.name: disable_assistant_inbound_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Disable inbound-call webhook notifications.

toolsPreview.name: enable_assistant_conversation_ended_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Enable conversation-ended (chat) webhook for an assistant.

toolsPreview.name: disable_assistant_conversation_ended_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Disable conversation-ended (chat) webhook.

toolsPreview.name: disable_assistant_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Disable the post-call webhook for an assistant.

toolsPreview.name: make_call
toolsPreview.description: Initiate an outbound AI phone call with a configured assistant.

toolsPreview.name: get_call
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a single call by ID.

toolsPreview.name: list_calls
toolsPreview.description: List calls with pagination and optional assistant filter.

toolsPreview.name: delete_call
toolsPreview.description: Delete a call record. Cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: list_conversations
toolsPreview.description: List conversations across your assistants with cursor pagination and filters.

toolsPreview.name: get_conversation
toolsPreview.description: Get the full message history of a chat conversation by UUID.

toolsPreview.name: create_conversation
toolsPreview.description: Start a new chat session with an assistant (widget=paid, test=free).

toolsPreview.name: send_message
toolsPreview.description: Send a user message in an existing chat conversation and get the assistant reply.

toolsPreview.name: enable_conversation_ai
toolsPreview.description: Re-enable AI replies for a conversation after a human takeover.

toolsPreview.name: disable_conversation_ai
toolsPreview.description: Disable AI replies for a conversation so a human can take over.

toolsPreview.name: list_campaigns
toolsPreview.description: List all campaigns you own (call, WhatsApp, SMS), including channel, schedule windows, and fallback config.

toolsPreview.name: get_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Get a single campaign by ID. Same fields as list_campaigns.

toolsPreview.name: create_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Create a draft call, WhatsApp, or SMS campaign. Starts in draft — add leads, then start with update_campaign_status. For channel=call require assistant_id; for whatsapp require whatsapp_sender_id + whatsapp_template_id; for sms require sms_from_phone_number_id + sms_body.

toolsPreview.name: update_campaign_status
toolsPreview.description: Start or stop a call, WhatsApp, or SMS campaign. Starting validates channel config, schedule, and balance.

toolsPreview.name: delete_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Delete a campaign. Running campaigns are stopped first. Cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: list_leads
toolsPreview.description: List leads with pagination.

toolsPreview.name: create_lead
toolsPreview.description: Create a new lead in a campaign. IMPORTANT: variable names come from the associated assistant configuration and are fixed; only their values can be supplied here.

toolsPreview.name: update_lead
toolsPreview.description: Update a lead. Variables are merged with existing ones.

toolsPreview.name: delete_lead
toolsPreview.description: Delete a lead.

toolsPreview.name: send_sms
toolsPreview.description: Send an SMS from one of your Famulor phone numbers (must be SMS-capable). Costs are deducted from your balance.

toolsPreview.name: list_mid_call_tools
toolsPreview.description: List mid-call tools (HTTP integrations callable by an assistant during a call).

toolsPreview.name: get_mid_call_tool
toolsPreview.description: Get a single mid-call tool by ID.

toolsPreview.name: create_mid_call_tool
toolsPreview.description: Create a new mid-call HTTP tool.

toolsPreview.name: update_mid_call_tool
toolsPreview.description: Update a mid-call tool. headers/schema fully replace existing values when provided.

toolsPreview.name: delete_mid_call_tool
toolsPreview.description: Delete a mid-call tool.

toolsPreview.name: list_knowledgebases
toolsPreview.description: List all knowledge bases on the account.

toolsPreview.name: get_knowledgebase
toolsPreview.description: Get a knowledge base by ID.

toolsPreview.name: create_knowledgebase
toolsPreview.description: Create a new knowledge base.

toolsPreview.name: update_knowledgebase
toolsPreview.description: Rename or describe an existing knowledge base.

toolsPreview.name: delete_knowledgebase
toolsPreview.description: Delete a knowledge base permanently.

toolsPreview.name: list_documents
toolsPreview.description: List documents in a knowledge base.

toolsPreview.name: get_document
toolsPreview.description: Get a single document by ID.

toolsPreview.name: create_document
toolsPreview.description: Add a website (URL-scraped) document to a knowledge base. File uploads (pdf/txt/docx) must use the Famulor dashboard or a direct multipart/form-data call.

toolsPreview.name: update_document
toolsPreview.description: Update a document name or description. Content cannot be changed.

toolsPreview.name: delete_document
toolsPreview.description: Delete a document from a knowledge base.

toolsPreview.name: list_all_phone_numbers
toolsPreview.description: List every phone number on the account (regardless of SMS or subscription status).

toolsPreview.name: search_phone_numbers
toolsPreview.description: Search for purchasable phone numbers via the Famulor provider.

toolsPreview.name: purchase_phone_number
toolsPreview.description: Purchase a phone number returned by search_phone_numbers (monthly subscription).

toolsPreview.name: update_phone_number
toolsPreview.description: Update a phone number you own. Currently sets the nickname — a short human-readable label (max 50 chars) shown next to the number. Send null/empty to clear it. Granted (shared) numbers cannot be updated.

toolsPreview.name: release_phone_number
toolsPreview.description: Release (cancel) a purchased phone number.

toolsPreview.name: list_folders
toolsPreview.description: List assistant folders (paginated), each with its assistants_count. Folders group assistants, e.g. per customer or brand; an assistant belongs to at most one folder.

toolsPreview.name: create_folder
toolsPreview.description: Create a folder to group assistants. Assign assistants via the folder_id field on create_assistant / update_assistant.

toolsPreview.name: update_folder
toolsPreview.description: Rename a folder or change its color (partial — only sent fields change).

toolsPreview.name: delete_folder
toolsPreview.description: Delete a folder. Assistants inside are NOT deleted — they just become uncategorized.

toolsPreview.name: list_labels
toolsPreview.description: List assistant labels (paginated), each with its assistants_count. Labels are tags; an assistant can carry multiple labels across folders.

toolsPreview.name: create_label
toolsPreview.description: Create a label to tag assistants (e.g. "inbound", "outbound"). Assign via the label_ids field on create_assistant / update_assistant.

toolsPreview.name: update_label
toolsPreview.description: Rename a label or change its color (partial — only sent fields change).

toolsPreview.name: delete_label
toolsPreview.description: Delete a label. It is removed from all assistants it was assigned to — the assistants themselves are NOT affected.

toolsPreview.name: list_sip_trunks
toolsPreview.description: List all SIP trunks on the account.

toolsPreview.name: get_sip_trunk
toolsPreview.description: Get a SIP trunk by ID.

toolsPreview.name: create_sip_trunk
toolsPreview.description: Provision a new SIP trunk (extension or DID number).

toolsPreview.name: update_sip_trunk
toolsPreview.description: Update a SIP trunk (partial).

toolsPreview.name: delete_sip_trunk
toolsPreview.description: Delete a SIP trunk by phone-number ID.

toolsPreview.name: get_whatsapp_senders
toolsPreview.description: List WhatsApp Business senders. status defaults to "online" — pass "all" to see all.

toolsPreview.name: get_whatsapp_templates
toolsPreview.description: List approved templates for a WhatsApp sender (status defaults to "approved").

toolsPreview.name: get_whatsapp_session_status
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a 24h messaging window is open for a recipient.

toolsPreview.name: send_whatsapp_template
toolsPreview.description: Send a WhatsApp template message (required when initiating or outside the 24h window).

toolsPreview.name: send_whatsapp_freeform
toolsPreview.description: Send a freeform WhatsApp message. Requires an open 24h session (use get_whatsapp_session_status to check).

toolsPreview.name: generate_ai_reply
toolsPreview.description: Generate a context-aware AI reply for a customer message. The system keeps conversation state per customer_identifier (e.g. phone, email, CRM ID).
